quotes.text: I walked up to the dock and they were waiting for me. They got me setup, went through the safety and I headed out for fun on the lake. The seadoo was fast as heck and so much fun. When I got back they were there waiting for me again. Great guys, rental and price.

H and his company are incredible! I rented jet skis from him twice in the last week. They always showed up on time and in great condition. He was thorough when he was teaching us how to drive them and super friendly. Definitely the highlight of my vacation!

These guys are top notch. Customer service personal (cell phone to your cell phone, text and calls) machines are wicked, and location for pickup/drop off can't be more central. Great experience. I rent from them every time I'm in town.
